evaluation: public LongBench v2 MiniMax M3 development screen; not a holdout or model-to-model comparison
route: OpenRouter; requested model and MiniMax provider are verified per response; allow_fallbacks=false

provider_endpoint.note: Provider family is pinned and fallbacks are disabled. Endpoint metadata can change; verify again immediately before the run.

budget.basis: local published MiniMax tokenizer rendered counts; provider usage is authoritative after calls
budget.actual_cost_basis: separate OpenRouter and upstream-reported fields; guard settles to the larger reported value when both exist, otherwise the available value; provider receipts are not invoice-verified
budget.input_estimate_note: Budget guard reserves 1.5x local M3 rendered tokens based on route-specific exact provider/local prompt counts from development and longest-case smoke receipts; dispatch closes if any observed ratio exceeds 1.05x. A separate 3.25x context projection checks the verified 524,288-token Minimax endpoint prompt limit. These are best-effort estimates, not provider-enforced limits or guaranteed invoice bounds.
budget.pricing_source: OpenRouter endpoint metadata checked 2026-10-16 for Minimax minimax/minimax-m3-20260531: $0.30/M input and $1.20/M output; configurable because endpoint/account rates may change.
budget.budget_guard_settlement_note: Reported provider cost when available; otherwise the reserved estimate is charged against the guard. This accounting value is not an invoice.

execution.generation_seed_formula: cli_seed + repeat + 1; paired arms share each case/repeat seed
execution.request_order: seeded shuffle across cases, arms, and repeats
execution.answer_format: exactly one option letter; only exact A/B/C/D outputs are scorable

preparation.tokenizer_count: MiniMax published tokenizer over published rendered chat template
preparation.sift_preprocessing_metric: per-request job.sift_preprocessing_ms measures compact_messages plus post-compaction token recount; null for full-context arm
preparation.provider_count_note: Per-request OpenRouter usage is authoritative; local token counts include a 128-token safety margin for Sift targets.

context_projection.note: The 3.25x projection is a conservative client-side check against the current provider-specific endpoint metadata; actual provider usage is captured per request.

preparation.cost_estimate_note: Historical local-rate estimate for offline preparation only; not a live route quote, invoice, budget authorization, or dispatch preflight.
